item.title: Navjot Singh Sidhu will return to active politics if Congress declares him CM face: Navjot Kaur
item.description: CHANDIGARH: Navjot Singh Sidhu will return to active politics if the Congress declares him as the party’s chief ministerial face in Punjab, his wife and party leader Navjot Kaur Sidhu has said. item.title: Delhi records ‘very poor’ air; IMD predicts cold wave
item.description: NEW DELHI: Delhi recorded “very poor” air quality on Sunday morning. According to the Central Pollution Control Board’s (CPCB) Sameer app, the Air Quality Index (AQI) at 10 am stood at 302, with 26 stations across the city reporting “very poor” levels. item.title: FPIs withdraw Rs 11,820 cr in first week of Dec; outflow reaches Rs 1.55 lakh cr in 2025
item.description: NEW DELHI: Foreign investors have pulled out Rs 11,820 crore (USD 1.3 billion) from Indian equities in the first week of this month, primarily driven by the sharp depreciation of the rupee.
